SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
File No. 7646
Date March 5, 1937.

Subject The "Emigrants' Thought," Russian weekly newspaper.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiew Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

On March 4, 1937 the local Russian weekly newspaper
entitled "Emigrants' Thought" resumed publication after one
month's suspension. It appears that during this period the
newspaper was reorganized. Professor M.P. Golovatcheff is
now the publisher of the "Emigrants' Thought" while the editorial
functions have been entrusted to a collegium. Although the
names of persons comprising the collegium have not been
revealed, there are reasons to believe that it consists of
several Russian ex-officers including General K.K. Akintievsky
(President of the Russian Ex-Officers' Club in Shanghai),
Generals I.S. Smolin and E.G. Sycheff and Captain M.U. Fomin
(President of the General Committee of Russian Emigrants
Association in Shanghai). The editorial and printing offices
are situated at 197 Route Winling and 55 Route Paul Henry
respectively.

A declaration of an "initiative group of active Russian
patriots" which appeared in the issue dated March 4, 1937 of
the newspaper in question, may be regarded as an outline of its
policy.

Referring to the much discussed question of the attitude
to be adopted by Russian emigres in the event of an armed
conflict between the U.S.S.R. and certain foreign powers, the
authors of the declaration denounce the harmful activities of
various groups of renegades among Russian emigres, which are
ready to become mere mercenaries of foreign powers in their
struggle against Russia. In particular, the pro-Japanese
clique of Ataman Semenoff in Manchoukuo - "the most odious of
such groups" - is mentioned.

On the other hand it is pointed out that the advocates

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一分署，
报告
档案号 7646
日期 1937年3月5日。

主题 《移民思想》（Emigrants' Thought），俄文周刊。

制作人：警探长普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiew） 转呈人：警探长 J. Boyne

1937年3月4日，当地名为《移民思想》的俄文周刊在停刊一个月后复刊。看来在此期间该报进行了改组。M.P. Golovatcheff 教授现为《移民思想》的发行人，而编辑职能已委托给一个委员会。虽然组成该委员会的人员名单尚未公布，但有理由相信其成员包括几名俄国前军官，其中有 K.K. Akintievsky 将军（上海俄国前军官俱乐部主席）、I.S. Smolin 将军和 E.G. Sycheff 将军，以及 M.U. Fomin 上尉（上海俄国侨民协会总委员会主席）。编辑部和印刷厂分别位于万灵路（Route Winling）197号和保罗·亨利路（Route Paul Henry）55号。

刊登于1937年3月4日该期报纸上的一份“积极俄国爱国者发起小组”的宣言，可被视为其政策大纲。

针对备受讨论的关于在苏联与某些外国势力发生武装冲突时俄国侨民应采取何种态度的问题，宣言作者谴责了俄国侨民中各类叛徒群体的有害活动，这些群体准备在反对俄罗斯的斗争中沦为外国势力的纯粹雇佣兵。文中特别提到了满洲国谢苗诺夫（Ataman Semenoff）的亲日派系——“此类群体中最令人厌恶的一支”。

（左下角印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / - 9 NOV 1936 / SHANGHAI）
（左下角批注：S.2. / informed / AB / 9/11）

The Russian weekly newspaper entitled "MIGRANTS' THOUGHT" which made its first appearance in Shanghai on November 5, is edited and published by Professor L.P. Golovachoff, residing at 278 Rue Tenant de la Tour, and is printed in a small printing shop situated in House 16, Passage 222, Avenue du Roi Albert.

From perusal of the first issue of the newspaper in question it would appear that it is intended to be a review and digest of Russian political thought outside the U.S.S.R. and will endeavour to facilitate the process of unification of Russian emigres on the platform of Russian national ideals.

Pointing out that the present time is the most critical epoch ever experienced by the world, the editor declares that the basic principle of the policy of his newspaper is " the firm conviction that only liberation of the Russian people from the communist yoke can save the world from the final catastrophe" He is also convinced that Russian emigres, as a part of the Russian people, are called upon to participate in the struggle of the latter against communism.

"It is just because the crisis is approaching that the newspaper 'Emigrants' Thought' has come into existence. To render oneself full account of the meaning of this crisis is not only a dictate of the natural instinct of self-preservation, but also an expression of will to victory."

"To organize the political thought of Russian emigres as a factor in the struggle for sound ideals is a problem of the day, without solution of which victory is impossible. The 'Emigrants' Thought' will be happy to be able to facilitate even in the smallest way the process of working out a clearly defined ideological programme of struggle against communism,

名为《移民思想》的俄文周刊于11月5日首次在上海出现，由居住在唐乃安路（Rue Tenant de la Tour）278号的 L.P. Golovachoff 教授编辑并发行，印刷地点位于阿尔贝王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）222弄16号的一家小型印刷所。

通过审阅该报首期，可以看出其旨在成为苏联境外俄国政治思想的评论与摘要，并致力于在俄国民族理想的基础上促进俄国侨民的统一进程。

主编指出当前是世界经历的最关键时期，他声明其报纸政策的基本原则是“坚信只有将俄国人民从共产主义枷锁中解放出来，才能拯救世界免于最终灾难”。他还确信，作为俄国人民一部分的俄国侨民，有责任参与后者反对共产主义的斗争。

“正是因为危机临近，《移民思想》报才得以诞生。充分认清这场危机的意义，不仅是自然求生本能的驱使，也是胜利意志的体现。”

“将俄国侨民的政治思想组织起来，作为争取健全理想的斗争因素，是当下的问题，若不解决此问题，胜利便不可能。《移民思想》报将乐于哪怕以最微小的方式，促进制定明确的反共斗争意识形态纲领的进程，
